privacy.title: Important notice
privacy.body: The device's video, switching and keyboard/mouse ports have NO authentication. Anyone on the same network can see the screens and type into the servers. Use this client only over an isolated management network, or through a VPN or SSH tunnel. Never expose the device directly to the internet.
privacy.public_host: The host you entered does not look local. Make sure it is reachable only over a VPN or SSH tunnel.
openh264.explain: The H.264 video decoder is fetched from Cisco's own host, verified against a pinned SHA-256, then cached. About 500 KB. No binary of the decoder is bundled with this application.
openh264.failed: Could not download the OpenH264 decoder.
about.unaffiliated: This project is not affiliated with or endorsed by the device manufacturer. All names are used for interoperability only.
confirm.enable_input.title: Enable keyboard and mouse
confirm.enable_input.body: This will let keystrokes and mouse events reach port {port}. Keep this off unless you intend to control the remote host.
err.switch_mismatch: The switch confirmed a different port. Session aborted for safety.
